reasons.POSTER_CONTENT_POLICY: Poster violates content safety policy (prohibited/offensive content)
reasons.POSTER_LOW_QUALITY: Poster resolution or quality is too low for physical auto printing
reasons.POSTER_MISLEADING: Poster contains false, deceptive or misleading claims
reasons.PRICE_TOO_LOW: Offered rent or printing allowance is below fair platform standards
reasons.DETAILS_UNCLEAR: Campaign title, description, or print instructions are ambiguous
reasons.UNSUPPORTED_AREA: Targeted city or zones do not currently have sufficient driver coverage
reasons.START_DATE_TOO_SOON: Campaign start date is too soon to permit printing and installation

checklist.policyCompliant: Poster contains no adult, illegal, political or hate speech content
checklist.highResolution: Image is clear, sharp and meets minimum resolution requirements
checklist.driverSafety: Design does not obstruct rear window, lights, or license plate visibility
checklist.accurateDates: Dates provide adequate lead time for printing and distribution
